name: Evercraft Deck Engine Founding Capital Fit Sprint
problem: A founder, operator or project owner needs bounded capital-path research, readiness gaps and evidence-led deck direction without fake approval odds or invented financing terms.
use_when: help me find funding for my business
which lenders or programs fit my business
help me prepare for SBA financing
find capital options for this project
turn my business info into a funding deck
what am I missing before I seek funding
inputs: Company/project name, contact email and use of funds. Optional capital goal, website, business summary, existing pitch, revenue/profit/collateral context and timeline.
outputs: Research summary, capital-readiness notes, 3-6 public-source provider/program candidates, requirements and evidence links, recommended audience and a 6-14 slide deck outline.
pricing: $49 one-time for the Founding Capital Fit Sprint, limited to the first 20 paid cases. The $49 is credited toward a later Capital Package upgrade.
confirmation: The user must explicitly confirm before checkout. Fulfillment starts only after provider-verified payment. No lender approval, eligibility, rate, term or probability is promised.
invocation_status: LIVE: direct agent HTTP gateway + OpenAPI + llms guidance + remote MCP at https://base44.app/api/apps/69c5b9c1c4406941ad277ad5/functions/deckEngineMcp. The stale vanity hostname is no longer used in the transaction path. Agents may prepare checkout only after explicit human confirmation; status independently verifies Polar payment and only a verified-paid machine case with the matching token may run bounded capital research.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
